requirements.description: int64 fields must be translated as Python int without truncation to 32-bit
requirements.analysis: Removed the & 0xFFFFFFFF mask. Full Python int precision preserved.

requirements.description: bytes fields must be base64-decoded from JSON strings
requirements.implementation: payload_str = data.get("payload", ""); msg.payload = base64.b64decode(payload_str) if payload_str else b""
requirements.analysis: Correctly uses base64.b64decode() with empty-string guard. Returns raw bytes, not string.

requirements.description: oneof fields must have exactly one variant set, not multiple
requirements.implementation: if/elif chain based on input key presence (has_text / has_binary)
requirements.analysis: Mutual exclusivity enforced via if/elif. binary_content path includes base64 decode. When neither key present, both remain falsy (defaults).

requirements.description: enum fields must be mapped from string names to integer values
requirements.analysis: Correctly maps string enum names to integer codes via STATUS_MAP. Unknown strings fallback to 0 (STATUS_UNKNOWN).

requirements.description: HTTP 404 from Service A must map to NOT_FOUND error code (5)
requirements.analysis: Changed from ErrorCode.INVALID_ARGUMENT(3) to ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND(5). Matches proto3 semantics for resource-not-found.

requirements.description: HTTP 429 from Service A must map to RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED error code (8)
requirements.analysis: Changed from ErrorCode.INTERNAL(13) to ErrorCode.RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED(8). Matches proto3 semantics for rate-limiting / quota exhaustion.

e2e_tests.description: Full pipeline: JSON -> translate -> consume without errors
Error path: HTTP 404 and 429 must reach consumer with correct codes

summary: All 6 spec requirements verified against implementation. All 12 tests pass (5 translation, 5 error mapping, 2 e2e). No regressions detected. Both Track A (translator.py) and Track B (error_mapper.py) fixes are correct and complete.
